pages.text: $(italic)Melee/Magic hybrid. Melee charges spells. Spells empower melee. Neither is passive.$(/italic)$(br2)HP Modifier: +5%  |  Equipment HP: Normal$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$(/bold) Swords (bonus), no ranged penalty

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Arcane Infusion$(/bold) — Melee hits generate Arcane Charges (max 5). Each charge: +6% spell damage (max +30%). Casting consumes all charges.$(br2)$(bold)Spell Strike$(/bold) — After casting a spell: next melee hit within 4s deals +20% damage with the spell's element.$(br2)$(bold)Mana Barrier$(/bold) — When hit: 15% of damage is absorbed by mana (if using Iron's Spells or Ars Nouveau).

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Elemental Attunement$(/bold) — 3 same-element spells in a row: Attuned (+15% damage, +10% resistance to that element) for 30s.$(br2)$(bold)Arcane Recovery$(/bold) — Kills restore 3% mana. Passive mana regen +15% in combat.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Arcane Surge$(/bold)$(br)Instantly gain 5 Arcane Charges. For 6 seconds, melee hits don't consume charges on spell cast. 60s cooldown.
